shellCommands.command: find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; echo "---DOCS DIR---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -type d -name docs 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "export declare function forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---SEARCH navigation.d.ts---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "function forbidden" 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "---FALLBACK---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -maxdepth 2 -name "navigation.d.ts" | head; echo "---grep export in any navigation---"; grep -rln "forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/*navigation* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "forbidden" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/router/router.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -45; echo "---BUILD EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}---"

npm run start > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
echo "Server PID: $SERVER_PID"
# wait for server to be ready
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "Ready after ${i}s"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "=== /admin response (status + body) ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/admin-body.html -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/admin
echo "=== body snippet ==="
sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/admin-body.html | tr -s ' \n' ' ' | cut -c1-600
echo
echo "=== / (home, should be 200) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/
kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
echo "--- server log tail ---"
tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log
grep -o "Forbidden\|Return Home\|does not have permission\|403" /tmp/admin-body.html | sort | uniq -c
